author: Tarheelkiwi
body:
I don't know if someone already suggested this, but I started thinking, moderators need to be able to go "undercover".  They would be able to temperately chance their IGN (just for the server) and hide their rank so players won't recognize them.  How many times have you been playing a game, a staff member joins because he/she saw your report, and a player said, "Hi PeachyYas!."  (PeachyYas is just an example).  Right there that player blew his cover and the reported player gets away.  Peachy needed to chance his IGN and remove his rank to he wouldn't have been spotted.  Then when the job is done, he just goes back to his real IGN and puts back his rank and continues with his day.

What do you think?
